games.name: The Backrooms With Guns
games.desc:
A game where you can fight back against the entities of The Backrooms, or fight other people, it's up to you.

Controls:
Sprint: Shift/Thumbstick Down
Crouch: Control/C/Button B
Flashlight: F/DPad Up
Hide Interface: H

Gamemodes:
Classic: PvE with Infinite health and ammo
Survival: PvE with Limited health and ammo
PVP: Fight other players

Some lower-end devices may experience performance issues. If you experience any, please set graphics on low and turn on performance mode.

⚠️ Breaking Roblox ToS, exploiting, or being inappropriate WILL result in ban, there are no exceptions.

⚠️ This game contains some flashing lights and visual effects that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy, viewer discretion is advised.

(TBWG was released on July 21, 2022)
